description.full_text: The image is a promotional poster for a mystery-themed role-playing game. The main elements include large Chinese characters at the top, with additional text below promoting a "new script" and "half-price" discount. The background features dark, eerie imagery, creating a suspenseful and mysterious atmosphere. Torn paper edges are visible at the bottom, adding to the intrigue. Red circular elements highlight key offers, and the overall mood is ominous and engaging.
